# Check that goroutine scheduling does not affect compiler output.
# If it does, reproducible builds will not work very well.
[short] skip
[GOOS:aix] env CGO_ENABLED=0  # go.dev/issue/56896
# Every build gets a cache of its own. GOMAXPROCS is not part of an action
# ID, so sharing one cache would answer the later builds from the first and
# the comparison would hold no matter what the scheduler did.
env GOMAXPROCS=16
env GOCACHE=$WORK/c16
mkdir $GOCACHE
go build -o http16.o net/http
env GOMAXPROCS=17
env GOCACHE=$WORK/c17
mkdir $GOCACHE
go build -o http17.o net/http
cmp -q http16.o http17.o
env GOMAXPROCS=18
env GOCACHE=$WORK/c18
mkdir $GOCACHE
go build -o http18.o net/http
cmp -q http16.o http18.o

# Check that goroutine scheduling does not affect linker output.
env GOMAXPROCS=16
env GOCACHE=$WORK/g16
mkdir $GOCACHE
go build -o gofmt16.exe cmd/gofmt
env GOMAXPROCS=17
env GOCACHE=$WORK/g17
mkdir $GOCACHE
go build -o gofmt17.exe cmd/gofmt
cmp -q gofmt16.exe gofmt17.exe
env GOMAXPROCS=18
env GOCACHE=$WORK/g18
mkdir $GOCACHE
go build -o gofmt18.exe cmd/gofmt
cmp -q gofmt16.exe gofmt18.exe
